generate_dummy_graphs: generate dummy molecular graphs with random edges, features, and labels for a specified number of graphs
generate_dummy_splits: create train/validation/test split indices by dividing graphs into three equal parts
generate_dummy_graph: generate a single dummy graph with specified node count, edge count, and feature dimensions
save_to_path: save dummy graph data and splits as compressed CSV files in OGB directory structure
combine_graph_data: flatten a list of graph dictionaries into a single dictionary keyed by column names
